description: Parametric 3D CAD from text (text-to-cad / cadgen / build123d): STEP, STL, GLB, 3MF.

tools.name: cad.build
tools.description: Make a 3D part or assembly from text with build123d (Open CASCADE): brackets, enclosures, gears, shafts, plates, fixtures, furniture, anything with real dimensions. You write Python that assigns the finished shape to `result`; `bd` is build123d (every build123d name such as Box, Cylinder, Pos is also in scope; do not write import lines). Units are millimetres, +Z up, XY ground. Example code: "base = bd.Box(60, 30, 6)\nwall = bd.Pos(0, -12, 18) * bd.Box(60, 6, 30)\nresult = base + wall - bd.Pos(20, 0, 0) * bd.Cylinder(4, 10)". Writes STEP (+ STL / GLB / 3MF), measures the model (size, volume, faces, solids, validity) and returns an isometric preview. If it fails the error is returned: fix that line and call again. Check the measured size against what was asked (pass expected_size_mm), and name every dimension as a constant at the top of the code.

name.description: Optional file name stem (default part); other characters become _.

code.description: Python statements (no function wrapper, no imports needed: bd is build123d) that end by assigning the shape to result.

formats.description: Extra files besides STEP (default stl and glb).

expected_size_mm.description: Overall X, Y, Z size the user asked for (any order): the build is flagged when the model differs.

assembly.description: true when several separate solids are intended.

tools.name: cad.inspect
tools.description: Measure an existing STEP/STP file: bounding box in mm, volume, area, faces, solids, validity, and an isometric preview picture.
